approved.en: Iran delivered a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes a gas pipeline deal, while Azerbaijan and Ukraine signed new energy defence and trade agreements and Zelensky urged Latin America to help repair Ukraine's power grid. Russia launched missile attacks on Kyiv, injuring residents and damaging the Northern Bridge, and a drone strike set an Ozon warehouse ablaze in southern Russia. Ukrainian forces struck the Saratov oil refinery and Russian ballistic missiles slammed Kyiv, causing further injuries. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

Russland gjennomførte missilangrep mot Kyiv, hvor innbyggere ble skadet og Nordbroen ble ødelagt, og et droneram satte et Ozon-lager i brann i sørlige Russland. Ukrainske styrker angrep Saratov-oljeraffineriet og russiske ballistiske missiler traff Kyiv, noe som førte til ytterligere skader. Dødsfall i kamper beløp seg til 75 767 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Israeli President has named a candidate to try forming the next government while opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot reports progress in coalition talks and faces easing of ultra-Orthodox draft opposition. Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens, and the IDF arrested three Palestinians planning terror attacks in the West Bank. In Gaza, gunfire damaged tents at the Rafah displacement site as aid teams prepared for winter storms, and residents built wind turbines from rubble and turned discarded cooking pots into seawalls. 21,440 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelske bosettere tok over åtte palestinske hjem i Jeriko, og forflyttet dusinvis, og IDF arresterte tre palestinere som planla terrorangrep på Vestbredden. I Gaza ble telt på Rafah-flyktningesteder skadet av skudd mens hjelpearbeidere forberedte seg på vinterstormer, og innbyggere bygde vindturbiner av ruiner og gjorde om kastede gryter til sjøvoller. 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israel is positioning forces to resume an offensive in southern Lebanon, contingent on renewed fighting with Iran, while Hezbollah continues artillery fire on Israeli positions and has begun cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The Israeli army has built a new road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone, expanding its presence near the border. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon by the fighting. 4,335 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den israelske hæren har bygget en ny vei i bufferområdet Shebaa-dalen, og utvider sin tilstedeværelse nær grensen. FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon på grunn av kampene. 4 335 dødsfall knyttet til kamp forekom i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

South Korea is extending anti-piracy patrols closer to the Strait of Hormuz, and Saudi coalition forces intercepted a missile aimed at Medina. 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces continue a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have seized the strategic al-Jawf mountain range, intensifying front-line fighting. The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi cruise missile and a long-range anti-tank guided missile over Riyadh, and downed a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Medina. A market strike in southwestern Yemen killed at least 20 civilians, and a missile attack on an oil tanker in the Gulf killed a sailor. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Houthi-styrkene fortsetter en månedslang beleiring av Taiz mens jemenittiske regjeringsstyrker har erobret den strategiske al-Jawf-fjellkjeden, noe som intensiverer frontlinjekampene. Den Saudi-ledede koalisjonen avskjærte et houthi-kryssmissil og et langdistanse-antitank-styrt missil over Riyadh, og skjøt ned et houthi-ballistisk missil rettet mot Medina. Et markedstreff i sør-vestlige Jemen drepte minst 20 sivile, og et missilangrep på en oljetanker i Persiabukta drepte en sjømann. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Israeli forces have carried out more than 60 cross-border violations in Syria since early November, including shelling in Quneitra and strikes in Syria and Lebanon. Syrian authorities condemned a terrorist attack on security personnel in Amman and an attack on Egyptian border guards that killed two officers. A 55‑year-old man died when an unexploded ordnance exploded in Hama. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelske styrker har gjennomført mer enn 60 grenseoverskridelser i Syria siden begynnelsen av november, inkludert artilleri i Quneitra og angrep i Syria og Libanon. Syriske myndigheter fordømte et terrorangrep på sikkerhetspersonell i Amman og et angrep på egyptiske grensevakter som drepte to offiserer. En 55‑årig mann døde da en ueksplodert ammunisjon eksploderte i Hama. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

En sikkerhetsvakt ble drept og tre personer såret i en skyting på et oljefelt nær Kirkuk. Tyrkia støttet irakiske mot-IS-innsats i Kirkuk og ønsket velkommen til forsterkning av grenseposter. The UN peacekeeping chief warned that RSF drone strikes launched from Ethiopian territory pose a new threat to civilians, prompting Ethiopia to expel six Sudanese consular staff and close Sudan’s consulate, while Sudan shut the Ethiopian consulate in retaliation. The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: City councils in Juba are now collecting over 600 tonnes of waste daily, most from Thongpiny, while road repairs and speed-bump installations are slated to begin within a week. The government is preparing climate-justice submissions to the African Court and addressing food insecurity worsened by El Niño and prolonged dry spells across parts of the country. President Kiir has posthumously promoted General Joseph Lagu to full General and the caretaker finance minister has pledged financial reforms as the UK reaffirms support. Machar said he took steps to prevent violence in Nasir and Ulang after fishing-net disputes sparked clashes, and a Kenyan preacher who urged followers to starve to death was sentenced to 200 years in prison. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Regjeringen forbereder klima-rettferdighetsinnspill til Den afrikanske domstolen og takler matusikkerhet forverret av El Niño og langvarige tørkeperioder i deler av landet. President Kiir har posthumt forfremmet general Joseph Lagu til full general, og den midlertidige finansministeren har lovet finansreformer mens Storbritannia bekrefter sin støtte. Machar sa han tok skritt for å hindre vold i Nasir og Ulang etter at tvister om fiskegarn utløste sammenstøt, og en kenyansk predikant som oppfordret sine tilhengere til å sulte ihjel ble dømt til 200 år i fengsel. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Somalia's Supreme Court declared President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud's term extension unlawful, prompting political uncertainty while al-Shabaab intensified attacks, including a suspected assault on a police station and camp in Garissa and a warning that Houthi support could boost its capabilities. Uganda announced its withdrawal of troops by 2027, with peacekeepers moving into bases near the capital as Ugandan forces leave, and the United States has vacated the strategic Baledogle airfield after more than a decade of use. Turkey is reported to be considering a takeover of the vacated airfield, adding a new external actor to the security landscape. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Uganda kunngjorde at de trekker tilbake tropper innen 2027, med fredsbevarere som flytter inn på baser nær hovedstaden når ugandiske styrker drar, og USA har forlatt den strategiske Baledogle-flyplassen etter mer enn et tiår med bruk. Det rapporteres at Tyrkia vurderer å overta den forlatte flyplassen, og tilfører en ny ekstern aktør til sikkerhetsbildet. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Southern Kaduna killings prompted HURIWA to request a DSS probe into possible political sponsorship, and a suspected herbal poisoning in Benue killed four and left 14 critically ill. The military recovered a cockpit voice recorder from a crashed plane that killed 25, and troops destroyed terrorist enclaves in Borno, forcing insurgents to retreat. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Joseph Kabila now heads a rebel coalition that includes M23, which has seized positions in Rugezi after a week of fighting with Congolese government forces. The United States has sanctioned Rwanda's defence ministry and its military bank Zigama and is moving to remove Rwanda and South Africa from the AGOA duty-free trade programme. An Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has killed more than 5,300 people and a UK doctor contracted the disease while responding to the crisis. The Allied Democratic Forces have returned to Lubero, rescued 29 hostages and continue to spread fear, while IS-linked militants killed at least 33 civilians in a village attack. 1,158 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Joseph Kabila leder nå en opprørskoalisjon som inkluderer M23-opprørerne, som har tatt posisjoner i Rugezi etter en ukes kamp med den kongolesiske regjeringshæren. USA har sanksjonert Rwandas forsvarsdepartement og deres militære bank Zigama, og er i ferd med å fjerne Rwanda og Sør-Afrika fra AGOA-programmet med tollfri handel. Et ebolautbrudd i Øst-DR Congo har drept mer enn 5 300 personer, og en britisk lege ble smittet med sykdommen mens han responderte på krisen. De allierte demokratiske styrkene har returnert til Lubero, reddet 29 gisler og fortsetter å spre frykt, mens IS-tilknyttede militante drepte minst 33 sivile i et landsbyangrep. 1 158 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The junta has expanded attacks beyond Myanmar, bombing a health centre in Thailand's Tak province and striking Karen positions in Mae Hong Son while blaming resistance fire from Thailand. Resistance forces used drones to hit a Christian Bible school, killing three female students, and an airstrike on a residence in Mrauk-U killed a pregnant woman and injured ten civilians. The military is proceeding with April parliamentary by-elections in conflict-hit Sagaing, Chin and Shan, extending voting to areas of ongoing fighting. Dead Starlink terminals are being repurposed to locate and kill people. There were 2,332 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Motstandsstyrker brukte droner til å treffe en kristen bibelskole, der tre kvinnelige studenter ble drept, og et luftangrep på en bolig i Mrauk-U drepte en gravid kvinne og såret ti sivile. Militæret fortsetter med parlamentsvalg i april i de konfliktplagede områdene Sagaing, Chin og Shan, og utvider stemmegivningen til områder med pågående kamper. Døde Starlink-terminaler blir omgjort for å lokalisere og drepe personer. Det var 2 332 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

En buss-lastebil-kollisjon på Hazara-motorveien drepte åtte personer og såret tretti, og en separat ulykke i Abbottabad og Bhakkar drepte elleve og såret tretti-tre. approved.en: Ecuador is experiencing continued high-profile violence, with authorities summoning seven people to stand trial for plotting to murder a candidate and U.S. prosecutors charging the son of former President and four others with cocaine trafficking.
